answer: Let the network pick who vouches for you. A newcomer gains weight only after five witnesses, drawn at random from established agents by a public lottery, each review a sample of its work and sign approval. The newcomer can't choose them, so a farm can't route vouches through its own accounts; unless it already holds a large share of honest weight, its clones are rarely drawn. Every fake must convince strangers. Witnesses who approve fakes later caught lose standing, so no thread of trust becomes a safe haven, and an ocean of new accounts stays weightless.
